dataset.name: Authored crossword smoke suite v1
limitations: Small authored smoke suite; not representative of newspaper crosswords.
Word squares repeat answers across directions and may be easier than ordinary puzzles.
Sparse blocked fixtures contain unchecked letters and primarily test structure.
The test split is held aside for local development, not guaranteed unseen by the language model.
No cryptic clues, rebus cells, multilingual clues, or image-extraction accuracy benchmark.

comparison: Paired initial candidates reused in all arms. Full agent may spend extra calls on retries. No token price assumed.

baseline_first_choice.stop_reason: Independent highest-scored candidate for each clue; no crossing search.

baseline_search.stop_reason: One constraint search using the shared initial candidates.

events.message: Checking candidate combinations against lengths, fixed letters, and crossings.
All entries fit. Correctness requires an independent answer key.
